finding.summary: Delivery/work/template/gate path guards raise Refused outside the main parser-error try block.
finding.evidence: A real symlinked --delivery-root invocation produced a traceback and exit 1, while tuple/preflight refusals produce the normal argparse error and exit 2. The guard still refused before writes; this is an error-surface inconsistency, not an unsafe-write bypass.
finding.recommended_fix: Move path resolution/validation into the existing Refused/RuntimeError/OSError parser-error boundary, or explicitly catch Refused around lines 643-657. Add an actual-main test for each path input class.
